newsitem.title: USA: Florida jobless rate unchanged at 5 pct in April.
newsitem.headline: Florida jobless rate unchanged at 5 pct in April.

text.p: Florida's unemployment rate was 5 percent in April, unchanged from March, state Labor Secretary Doug Jamerson said Tuesday.
The data represent 352,000 jobless residents out of a labor force of 7.09 million.
Total nonfarm employment reached 6.4 million, an increase of 236,600 jobs or 3.8 percent over April of last year.

Monroe County had the lowest unemployment rate in April, 2.1 percent, while Gulf County had the highest, 10.8 percent. Among Florida's 67 counties, 42 saw declines in the unemployment rate from the previous April.
Service added the most jobs, 119,200, and had the fastest growth rate, 5.7 percent, over the year.
Trade gained 58,200 jobs, an increase of 3.6 percent over the year. Construction increased by 7,600 jobs or 2.4 percent, while manufacturing grew by 4,700 jobs or one percent over the year.
The transportation, communications and public utilities sector grew by 13,200 jobs or 4.2 percent, while finance, isurance and real estate grew by 13,500 jobs or 3.5 percent.
Government gained 20,000 jobs for a 2.1 percent growth rate over the year, with local government growth more than offsetting a decline in federal government jobs

All of Florida's metropolitan areas posted job increaes for the year. Orlando added the most jobs, 43,300, and had the fastest grwoth rate, 5.8 percent, among the six largest urban areas. Miami had the slowest growth rate, 2.7 percent.
